system.description: Starting Move. When you fight using fire as a weapon, roll+CHA.

success.label: Success!
success.value:
You hurt your foe, but choose one:
• You cause unintended collateral damage.
• You suffer a condition, perhaps due to overexertion or a foe's counterattack.
• Choose and Burn one of your fire's traits.
• You draw unwanted attention from nearby.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: You hurt your foe, but choose two from the list.
